edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller and the airdrop recipient, becoming the destination of the token transfer.
msg.sender is hashed into the signed message that ecrecover validates against owner.
msg.sender is the 'to' address of the external token.transferFrom call.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged rights to the caller.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner to gate privileged functions.
transferOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
airdrop derives and passes amount into the external transferFrom call.
airdrop performs the ecrecover signature verification before effecting the transfer.
airdrop reads and sets users[msg.sender] to true to prevent double claims.
airdrop invokes transferFrom on the token state variable.
getAirdropAmount return value is stored in the local amount variable.
Local amount is the value parameter of the external token.transferFrom call.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
The owner assignment operation mutates the privileged owner state variable.
lock sets the locked state variable to true.
unlock sets the locked state variable to false.
MDTKAirdrop constructor sets locked = true, disabling airdrops at deployment.
BaseAirdrop constructor writes the token state variable.
BaseAirdrop constructor writes the tokenHolder state variable.
getAirdropAmount returns the PER_USER_AMOUNT constant.

Dividend parameter flows into the local division result.

newOwner parameter is written into the owner state by the privileged assignment.
